insights.claim: Agents manually re-triage tickets because the automatic assignment ignores account tier, so enterprise tickets land in the general queue.

evidence.note: Reassigned 4 of 6 tickets during the session, all enterprise accounts
Kept a personal browser tab filtered to enterprise accounts
Described re-triage as the first thing done each morning
17 reassignment events in one week, 14 to enterprise accounts
Median time-to-first-response 3.1x higher for misrouted enterprise tickets

insights.claim: Team leads distrust the auto-triage confidence score and ignore it entirely.

evidence.note: Said the score 'has been wrong enough times that I stopped looking'
Could not recall what the score meant

insights.claim: Agents would prefer a bulk re-assignment action over a smarter routing rule.

evidence.note: Asked for a multi-select and 'move all' button

insights.claim: Ticket volume spikes on Monday mornings overwhelm the triage step.

evidence.note: Monday inbound is 2.4x the weekday median across 12 weeks
Described Monday as 'the day triage does not happen'
Monday tickets show the longest untriaged dwell time
